name: makefile_eval_parsetime
title: $(eval ...) in Makefiles evaluates at parse-time, not run-time
symptom: A target works in one context but silently uses wrong variable values in another
cause: $(eval export VAR ?= ...) freezes the variable when the Makefile is READ, not when the target runs
fix: Put variable expansion inside the recipe, not in $(eval ...) at top level
mal_code: $(eval export TF_VAR_image_tag ?= dev-$(GIT_SHA))  # frozen at parse
